positive_generation: Fixed-seed shuffled unique main-native rare positives, then fresh real-row all-column equality anchors pruned in fixed random order while retaining 1..10 truth and at least five predicates; date equality retained for efficient exact counting.
zero_generation: Change exactly one original predicate value to another observed non-NULL in-domain value; preserve column/operator/count; all marginal counts strictly positive, conjunction exactly zero.
query_selection: Only frozen data/truth, never model estimates or errors. Targeted paired stress, not unbiased SQL sample.
cpu_methods: exact marginals; 10000-row sample seed20261109; parameter-matched MADE and ResMADE int32 rows seeds0/1/2; official ResMADE identical budget/sample alias, not extra independent sample
zero_metrics: raw estimates and >1/>10/>100 row thresholds, plus floor1 qerror diagnostic; ordinary qerror positive truth only
storage: FP32 trainable parameter bytes versus int32 rows; common dictionary excluded from both. PG catalog logical row bytes exclude heap/index/page/WAL/executable overhead.
